patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish lower lows/lower highs (decline from 1900 to 1725) to bullish higher highs/higher lows. Price broke above the 1825 swing high and is currently holding above it near 1836.

patterns_found.name: Symmetrical Triangle
patterns_found.evidence: Price is consolidating in a narrowing range after the sharp rally from 1725, forming lower highs near 1840-1845 and higher lows near 1825-1830.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Strong impulsive advance from 1725 to 1835 followed by tight sideways consolidation near the top of the move.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price has shifted from a downtrend to an uptrend structure after the 1725 low, but is currently consolidating in a tight range between 1825 and 1845 without a clear breakout.
